# Apply Impulse

Source: [4327](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4327); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Apply Impulse](../../api/actions/apply-impulse.md).

<a id="wiki-4327-n1"></a>

- Impulse direction is normalized internally; speed is the magnitude of velocity change.

<a id="wiki-4327-n2"></a>

- The default Cancel Contrary Motion first cancels velocity opposite the impulse; world/local coordinates are selected separately.
